facts.pricing_text: Desktop v0.0.14 Latest — github-actions released this (tag desktop-v0.0.14, commit f80e6a5), released 2026-08-19. Release notes (verbatim excerpt): "The app now posts native macOS notifications when a task finishes or needs your input, so you can leave Cline working in the background. Configure them under Settings → Notifications. … Models that support image generation can now produce images during a task, and they render inline in the transcript. … There is now a separate "Cline Code Beta" app that installs side by side with this one and tracks the experimental branch. It identifies itself as beta in the sidebar, Settings, window title, and tray, so you always know which build you are in." Also on page: pre-release "Desktop v0.0.14-beta.1" ("First beta release. Cline Code Beta installs side by side with the stable app so you can compare the two, and updates automatically from its own beta channel — stable installs are unaffected."). No pricing or free-access statement on this page; the change is a Cline Code desktop app release.

facts.max_credit: Receive up to $350,000 Google Cloud Credits to support your development costs over 2 years
facts.eligibility: Eligibility requirements — For VC-funded startups ready to Grow and Scale: Startups that use or plan to use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform or Gemini to deploy AI services as a foundation of their primary product or solution offering; Designed for startups that raised Pre-Seed/Seed rounds within the last five years, and Series A rounds within the last 12 months; Founded within the last five years; Not yet received more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits; Eligibility at the discretion of Google Cloud.
facts.usable_services: Program credits cover Google's state-of-the-art models like Gemini and Gemma. [5] 1. Credits can be applied toward Google Cloud Services and Select Google Cloud offerings, subject to the Google for Startups Cloud Program-Startup Terms.
facts.prepaid_conditions: Up to $200,000 USD in Google Cloud (up to $350,000 USD for AI startups)[4]: Year 1: 100% up to $100,000 USD in Google Cloud credits [1]; For AI-first startups: 100% up to $250,000 USD in Google Cloud credits [1]; Year 2: 20% up to an additional $100,000 USD in Google Cloud credits [1]. Note: Third-party models are billed directly and are not covered by the program credits.
facts.terms_text: 1. Credits can be applied toward Google Cloud Services and Select Google Cloud offerings, subject to the Google for Startups Cloud Program-Startup Terms. Acceptance into this program is at the discretion of Google Cloud. We are unable to accept companies that have IPO'd or been acquired, educational institutions, government entities, nonprofits, personal blogs or content, dev shops, consultancies, or agencies, cryptocurrency mining company, or a company distributing tokens contrary to regulatory guidance in your jurisdiction.

facts.max_credit: Receive up to $350,000 in credits for a year to support your startup. (Tier 1 — $350k: Unlock $350k maximum credits, Office Hours with experts, and priority technical support to scale globally.)
facts.eligibility: You qualify if your startup meets all of the following: Founded within the last 10 years (Your company was incorporated no more than 10 years ago); Funded up to Series B (Funded within the last 12 months); Building a technology product (Actively developing a technology product); Has a valid, publicly accessible website (Your startup has a live website we can verify); Active on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), or GitHub (Your startup has a public social media presence); Has not previously been approved into the program (First-time applicants only); For-profit business with a business email matching your domain (Business email required — no personal email addresses). Tier criteria: Tier 3 — Bootstrapped or self-funded, Under $1M raised; Tier 2 — Under $5M raised, Funded by an affiliated partner; Tier 1 — $5M+ raised, Funded by an affiliated partner.
facts.usable_services: Credits cover usage-based services. Core security and networking features are included at no cost, regardless of tier. Covered by Credits: Compute — Workers, Workers for Platforms, Durable Objects, Workflows; AI — Workers AI (up to $50,000); Storage & Data — Workers KV, D1, Queues, Vectorize, R2 (up to $10,000); Delivery — Pages, Images and Stream, Cache Reserve, Argo Smart Routing.
facts.prepaid_conditions: Once your credits are confirmed, all eligible usage-based features will be automatically deducted from your credit balance or applied at no cost as a program benefit. Product-Specific Caps & Exclusions: R2 Object Storage: Covered up to a $10,000 cap. Workers AI: Covered up to a $2,500 cap for Tier 3, $10,000 for Tier 2, and $50,000 for Tier 1 (standard partner model pricing applies). AI Gateway: Temporarily not covered by credits. We are actively working to make it accessible.
facts.terms_text: We recently updated our program tiers, increasing Tier 3 from $5,000 to $10,000 to give early-stage founders even more runway, and increasing Tier 1 from $250,000 to $350,000 to better support our fastest-scaling startups. If approved for an upgrade, please note that this does not reset your 1-year program expiration date. The additional credits will still expire at the end of your original 12-month cohort window.
